items.title: 13.11 Pani ki safai mein chlorine ka istemal (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.11, printed page 301.

blocks.text: Chlorine gas bohat zehreeli hai, magar thori miqdar mein yeh insanon ke liye be-zarar aur bimari phailane wale bacteria ke liye zehreeli hai. Apni mazboot disinfectant khusoosiyat ki wajah se chlorine pani saaf karne ke liye treatment plants mein wasee istemal hoti hai: chlorine pani mein dali jati hai, jahan woh aisi faal species banati hai jo bacteria aur doosre jaraseem maarti hain. Swimming pool ka pani thori zyada concentration se chlorinate kiya jata hai kyunke us mein bacteria zyada hone ka imkan hai. Bunyadi faal species chloric(I) acid ya hypochlorous acid, HOCl, aur chlorate(I) ya hypochlorite ion, OCl-, hain. Chlorination pani ki disinfection ka nisbatan sasta tareeqa hai.

blocks.caption: Chlorination ek nazar mein

blocks.prompt: Pani ki safai mein chlorine ke istemal ka ek bara nuqsan bayan karein (exercise Q.2l).
blocks.explanation: Chlorine pani ke organic madde se react kar ke trihalomethanes jaise chlorinated by-products banati hai, jin mein se kuch cancer ka shuba rakhte hain, aur yeh zaiqa aur boo chhorti hai; chlorine gas khud zehreeli hai aur ehtiyat se sambhalni aur rakhni parti hai.

items: Chlorine pani ko sasta disinfect karti hai: thori dose jaraseem maarti hai; faal species HOCl aur OCl-; pools ko zyada dose.
